method:
In this week’s lesson, we explored different ways to connect sound with images. We looked at how sound can follow an action, how it can be different from the action, and how it can create a new feeling.
This also made me think about my own creative work. For example, in our project 1, we could use soft sounds when the stones touch each other. We could also add natural sounds, such as wind or water, to create a peaceful feeling. I think sound could help make our project feel warmer and more emotional, rather than just being a simple game.
related_work:
In the lecture, Miguel Mera introduced how sound and images work together. One interesting idea was Synchresis, introduced by Michel Chion. It means that when we hear a sound and see an action at the same time, our brain connects them together.
We also learned about Mickey Mousing, where music follows the movements of a character. For example, when a character jumps, the music can follow the jump. I found these ideas interesting because they show that sound does not always need to be realistic. Sometimes, a different sound can make an image more interesting or give it a new meaning.
results_discussion: The most interesting thing I learned this week was that sound can change the meaning of an image. Even when the image stays the same, different sounds can make it feel happy, sad, peaceful or strange. I also realised that sound does not always have to match the image. Sometimes, when the sound and image are different, people may think more about what they are seeing. For my future projects, I want to think about sound earlier in the design process. I used to focus more on colours, shapes and animation, but now I understand that sound can also help tell a story.
title: week 5
introduction:
This week, we learned about the relationship between sound and images in our Ideas class. I learned that the same image can give people different feelings when we change the sound.
Before this lesson, I mainly focused on visual design. However, this class made me realise that sound is also an important part of an experience. It can change how people understand an image and how they feel when watching it.
